title: GET /api/v1/home response (contract version 1)
description: Reference API-driven screen contract for Story #1022. Governed by docs/product/API_DRIVEN_ARCHITECTURE_REDESIGN.md sections 8, 11, 25, 26, 27, 28. Full rosters, defense/batting grids, roster snapshots/history, and live scoring state are deliberately excluded — this is a summary read model, not a data export.

version.description: Contract version per section 25.4. A future breaking change ships as version 2 with a measured compatibility window, not a silent field rename.

generatedAt.description: Server timestamp the summary was computed, per section 25.1 ("successful reads return the resource/read model directly, with version and generatedAt in the representation").

requestId.description: Echoes the caller's X-Request-ID or a server-generated one, per section 25.1.

defaultTeamId.description: The team the Team Hub should expand by default (section 12.1: exactly one team is expanded). Null only when the caller has zero active team memberships.

code.description: Normalized canonical role per section 26 / backend/src/lib/normalizeRole.js. Never a raw legacy DB value (team_admin, coordinator, parent).

label.description: Product-facing label per section 26's mapping table, e.g. 'Team Admin / Head Coach' for code=admin.

capability.description: One capability string from the section 26.1 baseline matrix (e.g. team.view, roster.manage, game.start_mode). Resource state may narrow which actions a capability actually enables; it never grants a capability beyond the role matrix.

nextEvent.description: Null when the team has no upcoming game or practice on the schedule.

lineupStatus.description: 'none' = no lineup started for the next event; 'draft' = grid/batting order started but not locked; 'ready' = locked and complete.

id.description: Stable action ID, e.g. start_game_mode, view_roster, view_schedule. Stable across releases so frontend/analytics can key off it without parsing the label.

label.description: Contextual, team-named label per section 12.2, e.g. 'Start Mud Hens Game Mode' — never a bare verb.

href.description: Canonical destination per section 6.2/27. Always team-scoped for a per-team action; this is discovery only — section 26.2 requires the destination and any command to reauthorize independently.

disabledReason.description: Required (may be null) even when enabled=true, so clients never have to special-case a missing key. Human-safe reason when enabled=false, e.g. 'Lineup already locked for this game.'

name.description: Raw team name as stored. May collide with another team's name in the same response (e.g. two seasons of 'Mud Hens').

displayName.description: Human-disambiguated name for list/card rendering, per #1022 acceptance criteria. Equal to name unless another team in this same response shares the same name, in which case season/year (and age group if still colliding) is appended, e.g. 'Mud Hens (Fall 2026)'. Computed server-side so the frontend never re-derives disambiguation logic per section 6.3 (React must not invent business logic already represented by the API).

capabilities.description: Discovery only per section 26.2 checkpoint 1 — the destination and command layers reauthorize independently and this list grants nothing by itself.
